scope: Future design work. Preserve approved screens; the current mock is a review candidate, not blanket approval of all flows.

actionButton.loading: Keep label and size; prevent duplicate submission.
actionButton.copy: Short verb: Send, Create, Choose, Save. Use object text only when needed.

actionPair.largeText: Stack vertically; keep primary visually identifiable.

field.label: Visible, outside field.
field.focus: One existing border changes color; no outer outline. Invalid focus retains the error border.

select.presentation: Reuse the reviewed anchored mock select: soft 48 px trigger, trailing chevron, selected check mark, Escape/outside dismissal and arrow-key navigation. Searchable long lists use the shared selection sheet.
select.optionSurface: Transparent at rest including selected option; subtle fill on hover only. Selected check and weight remain.

checkbox.checkmark: Centered 18 px SVG check mask; translate(-50%, -50%) on both axes.

radio.selection: Exactly one choice per named group.
radio.selectedIndicator: Single accent-filled circle with an 8 px onAccent dot; no double ring.
radio.keyboard: Arrow keys move selection; visible focus.

starRating.semantics: Label each value 1–5; selected value exposed; keyboard selection.
starRating.unset: No preselected rating unless editing a saved review.

contextRow.editable: Whole row is one labelled change action, with trailing chevron.

identityRow.separator: One per row boundary; none duplicated before footer.

statusChip.placement: One row per record where width permits; wrap for large text, never truncate meaning.

variants.status: subtle fill with state icon and text
variants.recordType: transparent background with category icon and textPrimary label

sheet.footer: Safe-area aware. Paired actions use actionPair.
sheet.keyboard: Focus trapped, Escape closes if cancellable; restore trigger focus.

pageHeader.centerMethod: Equal 48 px leading and trailing slots; title centered in remaining column.

tabs.active: Weight and underline, not color alone.
tabs.horizontalOverflow: Scrollable if localized labels need it; do not clip.

searchAndFilters.advanced: One filter sheet with related criteria, explicit Apply / Reset.
searchAndFilters.summary: Do not add extra result/filter-summary lines to Walking Current.

toast.purpose: Short non-blocking acknowledgement on the originating screen.
toast.avoid: Standalone success page for a simple saved/sent result.
toast.successIcon: onAccent check without an extra badge

confirmation.title: One concise question.
confirmation.body: Only consequences necessary for a decision.
confirmation.avoid: Repeated action word in title, paragraph and button.

photoPicker.interaction: Direct gallery picker; optional explicit provider import as separate inline action.
photoPicker.production: Use private upload pipeline; mock previews do not imply storage.

emptyErrorLoading.empty: Short heading, reason and recovery if useful.
emptyErrorLoading.loading: Preserve layout and identify the real pending operation.
emptyErrorLoading.reputation: No reviews yet; never zero stars for unrated people.

mapContainer.unavailable: Honest unavailable state and useful list fallback.
mapContainer.publicPoint: Select a public venue point, never publish device GPS.

chat.media: Photos only; constraints come from security and chat-media requirements.

walkElapsedTimer.target: Fixed walk conversation context; live only after local Start in the fixture

timePicker.layout: Centered hour/minute pair with colon; left-aligned labels and 8 px label gap. Expand within available width for large text.
hints: Caller venue/request/service IANA zone; explicit unknown hint when unset
timePicker.zone: Required nullable context argument; never infer from device or unrelated account mode.
timePicker.footer: Shared sheet fixed action with divider; Done above safe area/keyboard.
timePicker.behavior: Validate 00:00–23:59; explicit Done commits wall time, close/back cancels.
timePicker.digitTypography: Body:16px Golos Text, tabular numerals; system text scaling.
timePicker.bodySpacing: 24px before pair (8px body+16px row);8px between hints;16px below body.

legacyDifferences.rule: Use the scoped typography token for new mobile components; do not resize approved legacy screens automatically.

legacyDifferences.canonical: General typography.control is 14; reviewed action buttons are 16/600.
legacyDifferences.rule: Use this actionButton contract for main actions; reserve 14 for metadata and compact tertiary controls.

legacyDifferences.canonical: layout.horizontalPadding is 24; reviewed sheets/lists often use 20.
legacyDifferences.rule: Keep 20 for the reviewed sheet pattern and approved mocks; retain existing 24 px page layouts. Migration needs review.

legacyDifferences.canonical: radii.control is 14; reviewed inputs often use 12; primary/secondary actions use pills.
legacyDifferences.rule: Use semantic token for new fields, pill for action buttons; preserve approved field silhouettes until a reviewed migration.

legacyDifferences.canonical: Mock CSS contains near-matching historical hex values.
legacyDifferences.rule: Use semantic tokens for new work; do not silently recolor existing approved views.

legacyDifferences.canonical: Token/native shared style is 20; some reviewed browser headings are 22 or 24.
legacyDifferences.rule: Use shared sheet heading for new sheets; preserve existing approved sizes until migration is reviewed.

legacyDifferences.canonical: Foundation avatar token is circular; person/pet rows use compact rounded squares in reviewed screens.
legacyDifferences.rule: Select shape by existing component role; do not replace identity images or all avatar shapes globally.

changeRules: Read instructions before every UI task.
Reuse the established component with the same intent.
Keep approved screens and archived versions unchanged unless the user explicitly authorizes that screen change.
Review new actions, destinations or flow behavior in the workflow map before implementation.
Archive the current candidate before altering it.
Apply shared component corrections to active matching uses, never frozen archives.
Document any intentional exception with its affected surface and reason.
Validate changed states and representative light/dark, large-text and localized layouts without claiming native/server verification from browser mocks.

browserAlignment.scope: Nine active mock sources; preserved screen structure and flows.
exceptions: Approved Nearby greeting and event hero scale
Time-entry digits: approved 18/32 px numeric style
browserAlignment.largeText: 200% role typography; paired actions stack and long labels wrap.
browserAlignment.reviewStatus: New destinations are design proposals; existing component contracts unchanged.

dateTimePickers.dateDisplay: Localized numeric date on one line; full localized tooltip; stack narrow meeting date/time fields.

filters.shortList: Anchored single choice menu; current check, roving focus, arrows/Home/End and Escape.
filters.relatedCriteria: Shared filter sheet; temporary draft; explicit Apply/Reset; dismiss cancels; focus restored.
filters.scope: All active browser filter entry points; approved surrounding layouts retained.

overlays.scope: All active browser sheets and full-screen modal hosts.
overlays.header: 12px 20px padding; 48px close target; 20px Manrope title; grows for large text.
overlays.body: 8px 20px 20px padding; internal scrolling; approved content/action order retained.
overlays.height: Compact content height; 88% maximum; header remains accessible.
overlays.radii: Approved 24px silhouettes preserved; proposal 28px sheets retain the sheet token.
overlays.behavior: One active dialog; underlying layers inert; focus trapped; Escape/backdrop use existing close action; return focus to opener; keep drafts through auxiliary pickers.

actions.typography: Golos Text 16/600; existing 200% text scale retained.
actions.targets: 48px actions/icon buttons; 56px minimum for large text actions; icons remain 48px square.
actions.icons: 20px centered with 8px label gap; provider marks retain 24px grid.
actions.pairs: 12px gap, equal width and height; stacked equal-height rows at large text.
actions.retained: Approved action order and placement, compact weekday/calendar selectors and compact Reset with expanding Apply.
actions.states: Shared keyboard focus, disabled opacity and enabled hover/pressed treatment; existing disabled/loading semantics retained.

forms.scope: All active browser review form hosts.
forms.labels: Visible captions outside controls; caption-only accessible names with optional hints linked separately.
forms.controls: Body typography, 48px minimum, 12px padding, subtle surface and one border. Approved 12/14px shapes retained; square manual fields use the reviewed 12px shape.
forms.support: 14px helper/error text, 8px spacing, semantic secondary/error colors; existing message copy retained.
forms.validation: Existing field/group errors linked with aria-describedby and aria-errormessage; invalid state applies to each affected field. Existing manual-city validation focuses the affected control.
forms.preservation: Drafts, field order and acceptance rules retained; search/composer patterns remain unchanged.

feedback.scope: Active browser empty/loading/error views and inline recovery states.
feedback.presentation: 32px 20px content padding; 18px Manrope headings; 16px Golos explanation; semantic secondary/error colors; shared recovery actions.
feedback.accessibility: Polite status regions; existing save alert retained; decorative indicators hidden; reduced motion respected.
feedback.retained: Approved surrounding layout, source copy, recovery callbacks, form drafts, disabled saving state; native/backend unchanged.

navigation.pageHeaders: 20px Manrope title, semantic divider, 48px targets / 20px icons; retain approved centered/left/chat identity variants.
navigation.bottomNavigation: 8px top / 12px sides / 12px minimum safe-area bottom; 48px targets; 22px icons; existing lime current pill with compact 12px label.
navigation.semantics: One current section; localized accessible names; legacy active classes supported; named tab groups; explicit button types; visible focus.
navigation.preservation: Root greeting, approved alignment, owner/helper ordering, back versus close callbacks, drafts and route graph retained; Review 40 preserved.

typographySpacing.roles: Screen 32/700 Manrope/1.12; body 16/400 Golos/1.4; supporting metadata 14/400 Golos/1.45. Existing large-text variables retained.
typographySpacing.spacing: 4px meeting metadata gaps; 24px helper introductory separation; 16px app introduction top margin.
typographySpacing.alignment: Copy columns min-width:0; long names/descriptions wrap in their existing columns.
exceptions: Approved Nearby greeting and hero typography
Approved 20/24px page insets and section composition

finalReview.scope: Final browser mock presentation audit; registered flow statuses unchanged.

previewFoundations.scope: Workflow host and mounted/nested references; memory-only account state and origin context; approved app presentation retained.
previewFoundations.pending: Zero remaining browser action proposals after Review 59; configured Auth/maps/GPS and native/backend verification remain separate.

finalEndToEndReview.presentation: Approved inline styles, CSS and all 127 screen definitions retained.
finalEndToEndReview.scope: Existing browser flow repairs; no new production authorization or external service configuration.

nativeReview60.scope: Flutter adoption of reviewed flows. Browser definitions and prior archives unchanged. Migration must be applied before configuring a backend with the new client.
